name: Zebra Wave
description: Fine horizontal stripes rippling across the sheet in long swells that grow toward the middle.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { overflow: hidden; :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; width: 100%; top: @calc(round((-100 + 100 * ((0.42 * sin(2 * PI * 1.5 * ((@x - 1) / @X)) * (0.35 + 0.65 * sin(PI * ((@x - 1) / @X)))) + (0.42 * sin(2 * PI * 1.5 * (@x / @X)) * (0.35 + 0.65 * sin(PI * (@x / @X))))) / 2) * 100) / 100)%; height: 300%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 4.1667%, transparent 4.1667% 8.3333%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 4.1667%, transparent 4.1667% 8.3333%); transform: skewY(@calc(round((atan(((0.42 * sin(2 * PI * 1.5 * (@x / @X)) * (0.35 + 0.65 * sin(PI * (@x / @X))))) - ((0.42 * sin(2 * PI * 1.5 * ((@x - 1) / @X)) * (0.35 + 0.65 * sin(PI * ((@x - 1) / @X)))))) * 180 / PI) * 100) / 100)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
